challenge.results: The complete four-line LICENSE is 268 bytes and reproduces the claim digest. The permission and notice-retention condition are in the same paragraph as the copyright, with zero bytes outside the cited passage. The Index decision assigns active to that exact representation.

limitations: The fixed-source interface supplies no SPDX aliases and the claim records supply no pinned SPDX URLs. Annotated tag release, target, and text correspondence or negative qualification remain unverified.
